The '''Galactic Trade Center''', also known as the '''Kaas City Craft and Trade Market''', was a major market plaza in [[Kaas City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], accommodating vendors of different trades. It also featured a [[Stronghold directory terminal]] with apartments in Kaas City available for purchase. The name "Galactic Trade Center" applied to the main building in the market as well, which featured [[Computer/Legends|computer]] terminals, [[Galactic Market Kiosk|Galactic Market Kiosks]] and bankers.<ref name="TOR"> {{TORcite|type=location|Craft and Trade Market|[[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]}}</ref>
